title: Closing the Loop: Branch-and-Bound for Scalable Verification of Nonlinear Neural Feedback Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.16298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite recent advances in the verification of nonlinear neural feedback systems, scalability remains the central obstacle, as state-of-the-art solvers do not yet handle the network sizes and nonlinear dynamics of autonomy applications. Combinatorial solvers do not scale to large networks, whereas propagative solvers excessively sacrifice precision. This work seeks to improve the scalability of combinatorial solvers by formulating verification as branch-and-bound on an abstraction of the closed-loop system. We introduce \rail, an interface that exposes polyhedral enclosures of the dynamics to LiRPA-style bound propagation, and \clipper, a branch-and-bound algorithm that jointly refines enclosures and splits controller activations. This framework enables joint reasoning on the computational graph of the closed-loop system, preserving symbolic correlations across time steps. translated_title: 闭环验证：用于非线性神经反馈系统可扩展验证的分支定界法
translated_abstract: 尽管非线性神经反馈系统的验证近年来取得了进展，可扩展性仍然是核心障碍，因为最先进的求解器尚无法处理自主应用中的网络规模和非线性动力学。组合求解器无法扩展到大型网络，而传播式求解器则过度牺牲精度。本工作通过将验证问题表述为对闭环系统抽象的分支定界，来提升组合求解器的可扩展性。我们引入了 \rail——一个将动力学多面体包围盒暴露给 LiRPA 风格边界传播的接口，以及 \clipper——一种联合细化包围盒并分割控制器激活的分支定界算法。该框架支持对闭环系统计算图的联合推理，在时间步之间保留符号相关性。我们展示了我们的构建方法，并证明其带来了显著的改进。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于闭环系统抽象的分支定界验证方法，通过 \rail 接口和 \clipper 算法联合细化动力学多面体包围盒并分割控制器激活，在保留时间步间符号相关性的同时，显著提升了非线性神经反馈系统验证的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates verification as branch-and-bound on an abstraction of the closed-loop system, introducing the \rail interface and \clipper algorithm to jointly refine polyhedral enclosures and split controller activations, thereby significantly improving the scalability of combinatorial solvers for nonlinear neural feedback systems while preserving symbolic correlations across time steps.
